method.component_pooling: all components across images, linear quantiles
method.pixel_shares: sum areas above threshold / all delta pixels; NOT per-image mean
method.pairs: directed exact class-pair masks; no component-size cutoff or cap
method.boundary: symmetric 4-neighbour seeds, Euclidean <=3/5 pixels, Ignore interfaces excluded
method.interpretation: test differences have no correctness labels; shape does not establish cause
